WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_purchase_ts
  FROM orders o
), top_categories AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, COALESCE(p.product_category_name, 'UNKNOWN')) AS category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price * COALESCE(oi.order_item_id::numeric/oi.order_item_id::numeric, 1) * COALESCE(oi.order_item_id::numeric/oi.order_item_id::numeric, 1)) -- placeholder to keep types consistent
      OVER () -- will be ignored; replaced below
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  CROSS JOIN latest l
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= date_trunc('month', (l.max_purchase_ts::date) - INTERVAL '23 months')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= l.max_purchase_ts
  GROUP BY 1
), category_rank AS (
  SELECT
    category_name_english,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price * COALESCE(oi.order_item_id::numeric/oi.order_item_id::numeric, 1))) AS total_sales_category
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  CROSS JOIN latest l
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= date_trunc('month', (l.max_purchase_ts::date) - INTERVAL '23 months')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= l.max_purchase_ts
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY total_sales_category DESC
  LIMIT 10
), months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', (SELECT max_purchase_ts::date FROM latest) - INTERVAL '23 months'),
    date_trunc('month', (SELECT max_purchase_ts::date FROM latest)),
    INTERVAL '1 month'
  ) AS month_start
)
SELECT
  cr.category_name_english,
  to_char(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
  COALESCE(ABS(SUM(oi.price * oi.order_item_id::numeric)), 0) AS total_sales
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN category_rank cr
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = m.month_start
LEFT JOIN order_items oi
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN products p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct
  ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  AND COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, COALESCE(p.product_category_name, 'UNKNOWN')) = cr.category_name_english
WHERE (o.order_id IS NULL OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= m.month_start AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;
